Title: Modules 'base' and 'player' contain entry 'res/layout/exo_playback_control_view.xml' with different content.
Description: 

### [REQUIRED] Issue description
I have an app with multiple Dynamic Modules. 

In order to add the download feature to my app, I need to import the `DownloadNotificationHelper` component into my "base" module. So I've added the ExoPlayer UI dependency : `com.google.android.exoplayer:exoplayer-ui:2.11.1` to my "base" module. 
Since I already have this dependency in the module "player" Now I have this compilation error message : 
```Modules 'base' and 'player' contain entry 'res/layout/exo_playback_control_view.xml' with different content.```

### [REQUIRED] Reproduction steps
In a multi modules android project, just add the dependency `com.google.android.exoplayer:exoplayer-ui:2.11.1` in the base module and an another module and try to compile.

### [REQUIRED] Version of ExoPlayer being used
Version `2.11.1`
